title: The Unsafe Room
lines: Jack had a room that was a big mess.
Dad said, "This is unsafe. Fix it."
Jack was unhappy, but he was helpful.
He slowly set the socks in a bin.
He had to redo the shelf three times.
At last the room was spotless.

questions.ask: What did Dad say about the room?
questions.listenFor: That it was unsafe and had to be fixed. Have them find the word unsafe.

questions.ask: How many times did Jack redo the shelf?
questions.listenFor: Three. If they say the wrong number, send them back to that line instead of correcting them.

questions.ask: Do you think Jack felt better at the end? Why do you think so?
questions.listenFor: Either answer. Listen for a reason from the story - spotless, or what Dad said last.
